task: Add an opt-in (global/per-project, off by default) secret+PII obfuscation layer with typed and failure placeholders under every codemie-code CLI analytics route plus a canonical sample set, and extend ticket attribution to Azure DevOps AB#123 and GitHub/GitLab #123 / org/repo#123 references.

key_reasoning.reason: Base XL: new shared obfuscation abstraction in utils/security plus wiring into the hook-adapter base (OtlpAgentAdapter/maskAndBoundFields, ~5 collectors and Claude Desktop cowork), copilot-cli free-text masking, proxy OTLP JSON masking and the currently byte-blind protobuf path, local analytics report and sync, the analytics setup step with global/per-project config, and ticket-parser/story-resolver/repo-fields. Bumped to XXL because it affects multiple collectors/agents and touches core shared utilities.

Closest pattern is the always-on secrets masking (security.ts EMBEDDED_SECRET_PATTERNS, maskOtlpJson); it covers secrets only. PII rules (email, phone, IPv4/IPv6, card, IBAN) with look-alike exclusions, idempotence, typed and failure placeholders with drop-only-on-placeholder-failure semantics, and protobuf decode/mask/re-encode have no precedent. Base L, bumped for security/compliance (data-protection) to XL.

16+ modified across utils, agents/core, several collector plugins, proxy plugins, cli/commands/analytics (report, sync, setup) and config; 6+ new (obfuscation rule module, protobuf masking module, canonical sample set fixture, obfuscation config resolver, per-collector pre-mask attribution tests and sample-set tests).

CLI interaction (setup step), service (hook adapters, ticket attribution), local persistence (global/project config, report/sync outputs) and the proxy/OTLP export boundary with a cross-cutting concern added in each; no schema migration, so L rather than XL.
ACs are concrete and no open questions remain; M because the 'configured tracker' notion in AC6 and the protobuf masking approach are design decisions not settled by the analysis.
Protobuf obfuscation likely needs an OTLP protobuf decode/encode library (or OpenTelemetry transformer) not confirmed present; otherwise only new config keys.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from XL to XXL: affects multiple workflows/agents (every hook collector, cowork, proxy) and touches core shared utilities (utils/security.ts)
Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: security/compliance (PII and secret obfuscation for data-protection rules)

Borderline 26/27: leaned higher because Technical Risk is XL and Component Scope is XXL. Calibration: nearest bundled XL example (epmcdme-10303-integrate-new-cloud-service) also totals 27 with a different distribution (heavier dependencies, lighter file count); agrees on band.

split_recommendation.ordering_note: All slices live in codemie-code. Attribution first because obfuscation must preserve the new ticket forms; the obfuscation engine and setting precede wiring the proxy/report/sync routes.
